name: Milind Patel
title: Web Development Manager
summary: Web Development Manager and hands-on senior full-stack engineer with 10+ years of experience (since 2015) architecting, building, and shipping secure web applications on .NET, Angular, React, and Microsoft SQL Server across Azure and AWS. Lead a blended team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers that owns 8 production sites and 12 API integrations, while staying close to the code — from ASP.NET Core Web APIs and Kubernetes deployments behind load balancers to T-SQL tuning and CI/CD. Owns PCI DSS compliance with 4 consecutive years of passed audits, and builds Claude-powered AI agents that take on complex, multi-step engineering work.

experience.title: Web Development Manager
bullets: Lead engineering delivery for a blended team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers — driving solution design, PR and code reviews, sprint planning and backlog grooming with Product, and mentoring engineers on clean architecture and secure coding.

Own the system architecture and hands-on development of 8 production sites and 12 API integrations — including Google Maps JavaScript API and Geocoding API for location and address features — built on ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Angular/React front ends, and MS SQL Server.

Run containerized applications on Kubernetes behind load balancers, designing deployments, health probes, horizontal scaling, and traffic routing with the networking team to keep sites highly available through releases and traffic spikes.
Partner with the networking team on firewall rules, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, and network segmentation for a security-confidential Azure and AWS environment, introducing remediation best practices.

Lead PCI DSS compliance across the Magento e-commerce sites, .NET applications, and React applications, passing every PCI audit for 4 consecutive years — compiling evidence with auditors, remediating vulnerability-scan findings (OWASP Top 10), and enforcing secure-coding standards in code review.

Build AI agents with Claude and Claude Code for complex, multi-step engineering work — codebase analysis, cross-application refactoring, test generation, and audit-evidence preparation — and standardize prompt-engineering practices across the team.

Run release engineering for multiple ASP.NET C# applications — branching and code-merge strategy, code drops and hotfix patches, and gated promotions from pre-production to production with impact assessment and rollback planning.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Built and maintained full-stack features across Rexall's ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework applications with Angular 12 and React 18 front ends, delivering RESTful APIs, reusable UI components, and third-party API integrations.
Designed T-SQL stored procedures, views, and indexes in MS SQL Server, and optimized long-running queries using execution plans to improve page-load and reporting performance.

Managed PCI DSS compliance across the Magento e-commerce sites, ASP.NET C# applications, and React applications — coordinating audits, gathering evidence, and remediating findings, with every annual audit passed.
Streamlined a security-confidential Azure cloud environment with the operations and networking teams, provisioning and configuring Azure and AWS components.
Owned code-merge and release work across multiple ASP.NET C# applications, preparing code drops and patches for pre-production and production and maintaining Azure DevOps build and release pipelines.
Served as the team's technical go-to — debugging production issues across UI, API, and database layers, reviewing pull requests, and leading project risk and issue management.

experience.title: .NET Developer
bullets: Designed and developed full-stack web applications with Angular 11 and .NET 5 Web APIs, working within an Agile team across every phase of the SDLC.
Built a RabbitMQ-based integration — message consumers plus scheduled SQL jobs that process queued events and generate downstream data — decoupling upstream systems from reporting workloads.
Implemented system-wide audit logging with SQL triggers and stored procedures that capture before/after record changes for traceability and support.
Upgraded and extended Telerik Kendo UI grids, forms, and charts in Angular, replacing custom controls so the team could focus on value-generating features.
Set up and configured Microsoft Azure cloud components and Azure DevOps pipelines for development, test, and production environments.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Partnered with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to translate user stories into automated process flows built in the AWD BPM tool.
Built rule-driven document-filtering automation using XML logic and Mobius Document Direct, removing manual document-handling steps.
Developed ASP.NET C# user interfaces for custom internal applications on a modern .NET backend.
Wrote parameterized stored procedures powering reporting and data retrieval across SQL Server and Oracle.
Built reusable SSIS ETL packages to ingest flat-file, Excel, and XML sources into SQL Server, plus DTS import/export routines delivering SQL Server data to client-side destinations.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built Angular front ends backed by ASP.NET Core Web APIs for internal business-process applications.
Designed and automated business processes in IBM BPM 8.5 — developing Business Process Definitions (BPDs) from requirements and deploying them to test environments.
Captured data requirements with business analysts through process blueprints and Visio diagrams.
Validated BPDs with positive and negative test cases, comparing expected and actual results through manual and automated testing.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Designed and built a School ERP platform on ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, Angular, and SQL Server that automated school back-office workflows and streamlined resource planning.
Designed RESTful APIs, SQL Server schemas, and stored procedures, and built responsive Bootstrap UIs across the application.
Worked directly with clients to turn business requirements into scalable solutions, owning scope definition, estimation, planning, and tracking for API and application development.
Mentored junior developers through code reviews and pairing, establishing coding standards across design, coding, testing, and debugging.
